notes.title: Check Out the Enhanced Potionomics Soundtrack
notes.content:
Quick, what’s your favorite song from the Potionomics soundtrack, and why is it this one:

[previewyoutube=TeX-F2sbW5U;full][/previewyoutube]

The acclaimed Potionomics original soundtrack is full of whimsical themes. Whether that’s through enhancing the vibes of a potion seller’s brewery, showcasing the (p)awsome power of two sea-faring felines, or even raising the romantic stakes with a toothsome rival, Greg Nicolett’s compositions bring Rafta to life. And now, just like the base game, we’re enhancing the soundtrack with even more musical cues. 

In addition to updates to some of the previous tracks, there are 10 brand-new songs we’ve added to the digital soundtrack – including a very special performance from Xid – and if you already own the soundtrack, you’re getting them completely free. If you didn’t already own it, why not? Well, at least you can buy the definitive version now. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142970/Potionomics__Original_Game_Soundtrack/

If you’re interested in learning more about the making of this memorable score, check out this behind-the-scenes video from the composer himself. 

[previewyoutube=lKZWdFN8Bng;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Voices and Free Love and Endless Mode, Oh My!
notes.content:
Hello Potion Sellers! It's been a while! Over the past two years, we've been busy working on a number of updates, both large and small, and exploring new ways you can enjoy all of [i]Potionomics[/i]. From expanded gameplay options to additional features, we’ve brewed up a bunch of enhancements to the game.

First and foremost, we added all-new voice acting for story scenes! We’ve further balanced the original difficulty, and included the oft requested additional difficulty modes, as well as Endless mode. Add in the new Free Love and One Love options, coupled with additional relationship scenes for Endless mode, and you’ve got plenty of choices when starting a new game – in more ways than one.

Of course, that’s not all that awaits you in the this [i]masterwork[/i] of an update, but we’ll let you get to selling and experiencing it all for yourself! Just one last thing – while many of you reading this may have been perfecting potions every day since we originally launched, we recommend starting a fresh save to get the most from all these free new features.

Without further preamble, here’s an overview of all the exciting, new additions to [i]Potionomics[/i]!

[h2]Major Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new Cozy and Capitalism difficulty levels, along with Classic balance adjustments to make the early game easier and the late game harder.[list]
[*] You can change the difficulty anytime after the initial tutorial (Starting on Day 3)![*] Cozy[list]
[*] Removes the time restriction on travel
[*] No time consumption when you rank up relationships
[*] Easier bosses in the potion competition
[*] It only takes one ingredient to brew a potion.[/list][*] Capitalism[list]
[*] Increased difficulty for customers (Average 20% increase in interest requirements for all levels)
[*] More difficult bosses in the potion competition[/list][/list][*] Added an Endless Mode after the game story is finished[list][*] Because of an edge case issue with cloud saves, a small percentage of users may need to re-clear Day 50 before being able to play Endless Mode.[/list][*] Added Free Love/One Love Mode options[list][*] In One Love mode, starting a romance locks off other romance options (as it's worked before)
[*] In Free Love mode, you can smooch as many people as you want!
[*] Note: These will require a new game and cannot be toggled![/list][*] Added one additional story scene in Endless Mode for every relationship path
[*] Added controller support
[*] New Language options in Deutsch, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文

[*] Boss Finn Content Pack as a paid DLC (Learn More About the Boss Finn Content Pack [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3240680/Potionomics__Boss_Finn_Content_Pack/]right here[/url])
[/list]
[h2]Minor Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a “Clear” button to brewing
[*] Added the ability to use the scroll wheel to quickly change bulk purchases when buying ingredients from Quinn and fuel from Saffron
[*] Updated the wallet to accommodate larger numbers
[/list]
Love,
Voracious Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3240680/Potionomics__Boss_Finn_Content_Pack/

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list][*] Xid cards - “Rhythm” doesn’t stack correctly. “Jingle” adds patience when used on 0 cost cards
[*] Victory confetti persists past the competition in some cases

[olist]

[Game Installation Folder]/Potionomics/Binaries/Win64
[*]  A zip of all the additional save data here::
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Potionomics/Saved/SaveGames
[*] Screenshot of your in-game config settings
[*] Your PC's DxDiag output as a .txt file (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4028644/windows-open-and-run-dxdiagexe)
[*] For visible bugs, please submit a video with ~30 seconds leading up to the bug occurring if possible.[/olist]
[h3]Trait Icons are hard to read [/h3]
If you are having trouble differentiating between the Trait icons due to the color, please reach out to us at support@xseedgames.com. We would love to get in touch and see what we can do to improve the icon design.

notes.title: Known Issues (10.18)
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow potion sellers! I hope you’ve all enjoyed your time in Rafta so far!

We wanted to let y’all know about some issues we’re aware of and looking into. For issues with workarounds, we’ve provided them here. If you have any more information for any of these issues, please let us know!

[h2]Roxanne is too powerful[/h2]
We’re working on taking Roxanne down a notch.

[h2]Soft lock after returning to title in the middle of a haggling session[/h2]
The following sequence of events will result in a soft lock and block user progress:
[olist]
[*]Pressing “Esc” in the middle of a haggling session
[*]Selecting “Title Menu” to return to the title menu
[*]Continuing a save without exiting the game
[/olist]
When you attempt to open the shop, the game will hang once a potion is put on the counter and fail to start the haggle. Other activities, like traveling to Quinn’s shop or trying to upgrade your cauldron, will also be bugged and block the user from progressing the game.
[b]For now, please avoid returning to the title menu in the middle of a haggling session.[/b]

[h2]Fullscreen display setting results in rendering issues[/h2]
Alt-tabbing while using the “Fullscreen” display mode, and any other activity on Windows that shifts the focus out of the game, will cause the game to only display a small portion of the screen.
[b]For now, please play using the “Borderless” display option if you are experiencing instability in fullscreen.[/b]

[h2]My save automatically started with one less time increment[/h2]
Using the escape key to exit to the title screen while traveling will cause a time increment to increase upon returning to your shop.

[b]Please do not use the escape key to go to the Title screen to reload saves while traveling for now. If you need to reload a save, wait until you have traveled back to Sylvia’s shop to return to the title or you will need to quit the game and start it again.[/b]

[h2]Checking the deck while haggling and pressing enter is a cursed activity[/h2]
If you ever click the deck while haggling and then press enter, the screen will darken and the text will distort the more times you press enter. We currently believe that this is Helene trying to claim your (the player’s, not Sylvia’s) soul, so please avoid doing this!

This will result in the screen being opened multiple times increasing the intensity of the darkening screen blur. You’ll need to exit this screen each time you open it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42290880/f0a95f869f77b7f2b1c40d85728f60a0f10dba0d.gif[/img]

[b]For now, please avoid tempting Helene and do not press enter while viewing the deck in a haggling session.[/b]

[h2]Characters are flying up in the air![/h2]
Some people are experiencing their fellow vendors floating up in the air. 
Closing and rebooting the game will plant them back on the ground.

[h2]Baptiste’s investing is unavailable after restarting the game[/h2]
Baptiste’s investment button is stuck on off on new saves. This happens because Baptiste was sent out on an expedition and the player started a new game by going to the title using the escape key. Currently the using the escape key to go to the title causes the game not to reset properly when new games are started.

[h2]I have cards that I shouldn’t have from a previous save[/h2]
Some players have reported cards from a previous playthrough showing up in their deck builder.. This is probably because the player used the escape key to return to the title to reload the game. Currently reloading the game using the escape key causes the game not to reset properly when new games are started.

[h1]Need More Information[/h1]
We need more information on these issues while we try to reproduce them on our end, so if you’re able to we’d appreciate if you sent the following to support@xseedgames.com:
[olist]
[*] Your save data located here:
[Game Installation Folder]/Potionomics/Binaries/Win64
[*]  The additional save data here:
 %USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/Potionomics/Saved/SaveGames
[*]  Screenshot of your in-game config settings
[*] Your PC's DxDiag output as a .txt file (https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/4028644/windows-open-and-run-dxdiagexe)
[*] If possible for visible bugs to submit a video with ~30 seconds leading up to the bug occurring[/olist]

[h2]Vendors showing up without any UI[/h2]
Some players have reported that traveling between vendors using the sidebar travel menu causes the vendor UI not to appear. If it’s occurring for you, please send us both sets of save data (as detailed above)!
A reported fix for this is using the travel map instead when selecting areas to visit.
